title: Financial Stability Report, May 2026
thesis: Valuation pressure, leverage, funding risk, and term-premium volatility are the live fault lines to watch before they become market prices.
why: It is source-backed, current, and practical: a top-down checklist for where fragility may hide in portfolios.

title: Global Financial Cycle and Liquidity Management
thesis: Domestic macro conditions cannot be read cleanly without the global dollar/liquidity cycle and the balance-sheet constraints that transmit it.
why: Good thesis fuel for understanding why liquidity, FX, and rates shocks can swamp clean company-level narratives.

title: Principles for Navigating Big Debt Crises
thesis: Debt crises follow recurring mechanics around leverage, incomes, currency, policy response, and political constraints.
why: A useful counterweight to daily market takes: slow-cycle mechanics, not headline reactions.
